pr_title: Fix crash on startup when there is no internet connection
pr_body:
<!-- Hey there. Thank you so much for improving NewPipe, and filling out the details. Having roughly the same layout helps everyone considerably :)-->

#### What is it?
- [x] Bugfix (user facing)
- [ ] Feature (user facing)
- [ ] Codebase improvement (dev facing)
- [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing)

#### Description of the changes in your PR
The crash was caused by an `Observable`'s `Callable` returning `null` when fetching the latest available app version without internet connection, but RxJava's `Observable`s do not accept `null` results. So I used a `Maybe` instead, and removed a `null` check inside the subscriber since nullity is already taken care of by the `Maybe`. I also did some refactoring in the `CheckForNewAppVersion` file.

A further crash was caused by the `onError()` interface not being implemented. That produced a crash instead of handling the connectivity error.

#### Fixes the following issue(s)
Fixes #4920

#### APK testing 
[app-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/5577476/app-debug.zip)

#### Due diligence
- [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
pr_comments:
Can confirm that it's fixed now.
Thanks

@TobiGr I approve your changes. I added a PR to move all of the error handling in one place (no need to try-catch in the callable, if the exception would be handled by the error lambda). I also used the shortand way to log exceptions with also a message (i.e. `Log.w(TAG, msg, exception)`, which, by looking at the code, is equal to `Log.w(TAG, msg + '\n' + getStackTraceString(exception))`). I tested as you said and also disabled the connectivity check at the top of the callable, to force network issues in the downloader, and everything works as expected.
Apk with `isGithubApk` returning always `true` and connectivity checks disabled: [app-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/5579477/app-debug.zip)
